## 1. Mandate

Pillar 3's seventh decision-record scenario. The scoping pass (a read-only
survey re-verified line by line against the live tree) selected the one
shipped decision face with a documented contract and provably zero prior
coverage in the benchmark lanes: the **Jiang reconstruction flag** of
`ms_compare`. The zero-coverage finding was established three ways -- the
scenario lanes consume the face only on its hungarian half
(`bench/scenarios/run_atlas.R`), the pillar-2 jiang lane reaches the
internal helper with `catalogs = NULL, signatures_est = NULL` so the flag
branch provably never executes in any lane, and the m1s/SBS lane carries
no cosine or `ms_compare` content at all (a banked note claiming it did was
refuted against the live tree and corrected here, per the
verify-by-command protocol). Rails held: decision-record framing only,
exported faces only, planted truth as the only ground, no new estimation
machinery.

## 2. The planted question

The shipped flag (`R/ms-compare.R`, gated block at 337-356 reading the
defaults `reconstruction_cosine = 0.969` at 37, scalar at 359-366) answers
one question per catalog column: does the reconstruction
`signatures_est %*% exposures_est` reproduce that column's shape within the
cited cosine line? The face contract is documented on the exported
generic (`@param catalogs` / `@param signatures_est`, `NAMESPACE` export);
the shape and protocol gates (583-621) are spoken through the face, not
bypassed. The provenance law is load-bearing for the reading: 0.969 is a
CITED upstream median, never an anchor -- `bbaf042` (research-02,
`vignettes/articles/research-02-fitting-inference.qmd` lines 54 and 129)
establishes that cosine above it still tolerates thousands of distinct
attributions, so the flag is necessary, not sufficient. The scenario
therefore records what the flag DOES on planted truth, never what the line
means about real fits.

The scenario plants a four-signature SBS96-subset dictionary (bundled bytes,
measured pairwise separable: maximum off-diagonal cosine 0.0707) and eight
count-scale samples with a circulant full-support weight design (every
signature carries a strict fraction of every sample's total), then drives
five arms through the exported face alone: the linear-expectation twin
(exact), the seeded stochastic cohort (clean), a committed dictionary
rotation (artifakt), a zeroed column (degenerate), and a deterministic
corruption ladder blending the exposures toward their own rotated twin.

## 3. Measured results

- **Hard rails held.** Both clean arms (exact and stochastic) report
  `share_reasonable == 1`; the rotation arm reports `share_reasonable == 0`
  with its median below the line; the zeroed column speaks exactly one NA
  bit at the planted column while the survivors keep the clean verdict.
  The dual-derivation legs pin the flag's per-sample floats EXACTLY against
  a hand-written cosine expression (portable arithmetic only -- this is the
  cross-platform posture: integer verdict bytes are byte-frozen, the float
  columns are censused and dual-derived, never demanded as foreign-platform
  bytes).
- **The committed ladder fact.** The corruption ladder is monotone
  non-increasing in the blend weight, rung 0 reads the clean verdict, and
  its last passing rung is committed at 0.32 as an observed fact at the
  frozen plant -- never asserted a priori, never generalized.
- **A domain law earned, not assumed.** The pre-write finiteness census
  REFUSED the first ignition: `cos(x, x)` measures at one ulp above unity
  (1.0000000000000002) on two of eight columns of this platform's sqrt
  path -- the mathematically closed domain [0, 1] is not representation-
  closed. The census now demands `<= 1 + 4 * .Machine$double.eps`, a
  one-ulp domain slack with the probe recorded, so an alive column can
  never be reddeed by representation alone and no off-domain byte can slip
  through. The refusal-and-repair is the law working, and it is banked
  with the CS-5 finiteness incident as the same family.
- Determinism: the flag path is RNG-free; the always-on null Monte Carlo
  (659 onward) is seed-frozen at the committed `cmp_seed`; both arms' bytes
  reproduce identically across independent ignitions (`DET=IDENTICAL`).

## 5. The paper face

The scenario enters the paper as the seventh §3.4 bullet and the seventh
Fig. 5 panel, pre-referenced to the PR number verified from the issue-PR
number space before citation (#115). The scenarios page gains the seventh
live leg -- three adjudications re-run through the exported face against
the committed bytes (hard rails, NA bit, monotone ladder with its committed
rung) -- and the seventh register row; the docs bridge and the pkgdown
article list each gain their row. The declined-scope rails are spoken by the
runner's own `[attest]` lines and grepped by the law: decision-record only,
cited-line-not-anchor, no bootstrap, no intervals, no conformal framing,
sanity harness untouched, bundled dictionary only, exported face only.
